currency_note.fx_assumption: 1 RMB = 1.088 HKD (approximate mid-2026 spot). Intrinsic values are calculated in RMB per share and converted to HKD for comparison with the market price. Current HKD 21.66 = RMB 19.91 per share.

inputs.net_debt_note: Negative net debt = net cash position. FY2025 gearing ratio -13.5% (net cash). Debt repaid materially in FY2025; operating cash inflow RMB18.8B.
inputs.last_fcf_note: Normalized FCF = 60% of FY2025 net profit (RMB3,514.6M). Note: FY2025 reported operating cash inflow was RMB18.8B (elevated by working capital release). 60% net profit conversion used as steady-state proxy for capital-light EMS FCF generation.

historical_growth.eps_5yr_note: Negative EPS/NP 5yr CAGR because FY2020 was an anomalous profit peak (COVID-driven electronics demand surge; NP RMB5,441M). FY2025 NP RMB3,515M is well below FY2020. 3yr CAGR from FY2022 trough is also distorted upward. Equity CAGR is the cleanest measure.
historical_growth.growth_rate_rationale: Equity 3yr CAGR (10.34%) selected as the primary growth anchor. Revenue CAGRs (19-20%) overstate sustainable earnings growth given structural margin compression. EPS/NP CAGRs are distorted by FY2020 COVID peak and FY2025 trough. Equity CAGR reflects actual retained earnings compounding and is most appropriate for a value-investing base. Scenario growth rates are then adjusted around this anchor based on business-specific drivers.
historical_growth.divergence_note: Equity 5yr CAGR (9.1%) vs Revenue 5yr CAGR (19.7%) divergence of 10.6pp does not breach the 30pp absolute threshold but reflects the reality that revenue growth has not translated proportionally to equity/earnings growth due to thin and variable margins. Treated as context, not a mechanical warning.

base.growth_rate_rationale: Y1 (8%): cautious given FY2026 consensus rev ~+2.6% and consumer electronics headwinds; FCF recovers from FY2025 trough as NEV scales. Y2-Y3 (10-11%): NEV segment sustains rapid growth, AI data center begins to contribute, foldable iPhone launches. Y4-Y5 (10-8%): gradual deceleration toward terminal growth as business matures.

bull.growth_rate_rationale: NEV segment sustains 50%+ growth (H1 2025 run-rate); AI data center wins major hyperscaler contracts; foldable iPhone launches late 2026 with BYD-E as key structural component supplier; Apple smart home adds new revenue layer. FCF margin expands as higher-value segments grow faster than assembly.

bear.growth_rate_rationale: Apple casing material shift (aluminium/3D-print) structurally reduces component ASP from 2026-27; consumer electronics demand deteriorates beyond consensus forecasts; AI data center commercial ramp delayed to 2028+; geopolitical risk causes Apple to accelerate India/Vietnam shift. Margins remain compressed.

base.upside_note: Upside calculated vs HKD 21.66 market price using HKD intrinsic value

base.note: Entry price to achieve 15% CAGR to terminal value per share. Current price HKD 21.66 is well above this entry level, implying the base case DCF does not support a 15% CAGR return from current price.

sensitivity.matrix_note: Rows = WACC (8.5% to 12.5%), Columns = Terminal Growth Rate (2.0% to 4.0%). Values in HKD per share. Base case at WACC 10.5% / TG 3.0% = HKD 21.31.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Equal weighting to bull/bear tails (25% each). Base case carries 50% weight. Bull scenario probability kept at 25% due to material execution risks in AI data center ramp and uncertainty around Apple material shift. Bear scenario at 25% given that the stock has already de-rated significantly (-49% from 52-week high) and NEV growth is demonstrably strong.

fy2025_actuals.ebitda_note: Estimated EBITDA: EBIT = NP / (1 - 0.28 tax) = ~4,881M; D&A = ~2.5% of revenue = ~4,487M; total EBITDA ~9,368M.

sanity_check.commentary: All implied multiples at the base intrinsic value are within plausible bounds for a high-volume, low-margin EMS company. P/E of 12.6x is in line with historical trading range (10-20x) and the current market multiple (12.8x). EV/EBITDA of 4.0x is at the low end of the EMS sector range (6-12x), reflecting the thin margin and execution risk. P/B of 1.28x is slightly below historical lows (~1.5x). The base IV (HKD 21.31) is essentially at fair value vs. the current market price (HKD 21.66), suggesting the stock is fairly priced in the base scenario. No auto-fix was required.

valuation_philosophy.framework: Conservative DCF anchored to equity book value CAGR
key_considerations: BYD Electronic is a high-revenue, low-margin EMS business: RMB179B revenue generates only RMB3.5B net profit (~2% net margin). Small margin changes have outsized earnings impact.

Equity CAGR (10.3% 3yr) is used as the primary growth anchor rather than revenue CAGR (18.75%) because revenue growth has not translated proportionally to shareholder value due to margin dilution from the Jabil acquisition integration and product mix shift.
Net cash position (RMB6.4B) provides meaningful balance sheet support and reduces downside risk, adding ~HKD2.74/share of intrinsic value floor.
NEV and AI data center are real growth drivers but remain early-stage contributors (<16% and <1% of revenue respectively). Base case does not price in transformational outcomes from these segments.
The FY2025 FCF base of RMB2,109M (60% of net profit) is conservative vs. reported operating cash (RMB18.8B) but normalized for working capital volatility inherent in EMS businesses.

At the current price of HKD21.66, the stock appears fairly valued in the base case (intrinsic value HKD21.31). The probability-weighted IV of HKD22.75 suggests modest upside (~5%), with the real return asymmetry being in the bull case (HKD33.55, +55%) if NEV/AI thesis materialises.
